landing.process_title: From bank statement to reviewed returns.
landing.process_body: A repeatable workflow for each client’s books. Explore it with synthetic data in the bureau demo.
landing.step1_body: Start with statement imports. Open banking remains a read-only candidate; no provider is connected by default.
landing.step2_body: Keep invoices, bills and evidence together in each client’s books.
landing.step3_body: Review suggested matches and supporting evidence before confirming a posting.
landing.step4_body: Prepare and review VAT workpapers for export. Direct tax submission remains gated.

landing.old2: Payment matches explained in a separate spreadsheet.
landing.old3: Client books spread across disconnected folders.
landing.old4: VAT figures copied into another workbook.
landing.new1: Invoices, bills and evidence in one workspace.
landing.new2: Review payment matches alongside their evidence.
landing.new3: Separate client books with a shared overview.
landing.new4: VAT workpapers to review before export.
landing.title: Open bookkeeping
landing.headline: Bookkeeping that stays clear. For every client.
landing.lede: Run the books and payroll for your UK and Estonian clients in one calm workspace. Review documents, reconcile payments and prepare UK and Estonian VAT workpapers with confidence.
landing.invoice_body: Country-aware invoices, credit notes, payments, reminders, and a complete receivables trail.
landing.reconcile_body: Import statements, match with evidence and documents, and review ambiguity before anything posts.
landing.review_body: VAT workpapers, ledgers, reports, evidence, audit history, and explicit filing-agent plans.
landing.hero_sub: Review invoices, reconcile payments and prepare UK and Estonian VAT workpapers in one workspace.
landing.hero_trust: Open source · UK and Estonia · Your books, your control
landing.suite_label: One suite. The same simple pricing.
landing.faq1_a: FastAccounts is open-source bookkeeping software for UK and Estonian small businesses and accounting bureaus. It brings invoices, bills, banking, ledgers and VAT workpapers into one workspace.
landing.faq2_q: What is the difference between BYOC and hosted?
landing.faq2_a: Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) is free: you run FastAccounts on your own infrastructure and manage updates. Hosting with us costs €1 per product per month on FastSME-managed infrastructure.
landing.faq3_a: FastAccounts covers UK and Estonian bookkeeping and VAT workpapers. Estonian payroll for accounting bureaus is in demo scope; production user acceptance testing is still pending. Direct tax submission remains gated.
landing.faq4_q: Can I inspect the code and self-host?
landing.faq4_a: Yes. FastAccounts is available on GitHub under the MIT license. You can use, modify and self-host it under that license, retaining its copyright and permission notice.
landing.faq5_a: The catalogue includes tested adapters for QuickBooks Online, Xero and Merit Aktiva. No provider is connected by default. HMRC and Estonian tax submission remain gated, and open banking is a read-only candidate. Employee master data and payroll inputs from client HR systems are on the roadmap; no HR adapter is built yet. See the integrations page for scope and review requirements.
landing.cta_title: Give every client's books a clear home.
landing.cta_body: Start with your workspace, or explore the source and host FastAccounts yourself.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.headline: Connect the tools your accountant already uses.
integrations.lede: FastAccounts can exchange data through tested provider adapters while making direction, ownership, review, and conflicts visible. No provider below is connected by default, and tax submission remains gated.
integrations.review_notice: Imports and exports produce reconciliation records. Direct tax submission stays disabled until provider approval, accountant UAT, and explicit finalisation controls are complete.

quickbooks.description: Coexist with an existing QuickBooks company through reviewed imports and controlled exports.

xero.name: Xero
xero.description: Exchange accounting data with a Xero organisation using tenant-scoped OAuth and explicit conflict review.

hibob.name: Bob (HiBob)
hibob.description: Bring selected Bob workforce data into a reviewed bureau-payroll intake.

zoho_people.name: Zoho People
zoho_people.description: Use Zoho People records and working-time data as reviewed payroll inputs.

employment_hero.name: Employment Hero
employment_hero.description: Stage selected Employment Hero workforce data for review before it enters bureau payroll.

workday.name: Workday
workday.description: Treat enterprise HCM worker and payroll-input data as a reviewed source for bureau payroll.

hrmaster.name: HRmaster (HR Master)
hrmaster.description: Use the Hungarian HR suite as a reviewed source for employee records and payroll inputs.

gusto.name: Gusto
gusto.description: Use the US payroll platform as a reviewed source where a client group includes a US entity.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.description: Bring selected workforce records into a reviewed payroll intake for client books.

deel.name: Deel
deel.description: Use global payroll and employer-of-record data as reviewed inputs for bureau payroll.

odoo_hr.name: Odoo HR
odoo_hr.description: Configure each tenant with its Odoo URL and database name for reviewed imports over XML-RPC or JSON-RPC.

persona_fujitsu.name: Fujitsu Persona
persona_fujitsu.description: Estonia's oldest personnel and payroll software has served organisations since 1995. Its modules can supply reviewed employee and payroll inputs.

wemply.name: Wemply
wemply.description: A modular staffing, working-time and Estonian payroll platform used by more than 1,000 companies. Wemply was named Aasta HR lahendus 2025.

hours24.name: hours24
hours24.description: AI-assisted time tracking and scheduling used in Estonia and Finland. A free tier supports up to five employees.

yester.name: Yester
yester.description: An Estonian workforce platform operating since 2000, with onboarding, expenses, travel and driving logs. It is tightly integrated with Merit Tarkvara.

hrm4baltics.name: HRM4Baltics (Digmatix)
hrm4baltics.description: A Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central HRM solution covering Estonian, Latvian and Lithuanian payroll. It includes X-tee integration.

merit_palk.name: Merit Palk
merit_palk.description: Estonia's most-used payroll software serves more than 25,000 firms and offers a free tier for up to two employees. It can pair with the existing Merit Aktiva accounting adapter.

taavi_palk.name: Taavi Palk
taavi_palk.description: An Estonian payroll product used by more than 1,500 companies. It prepares statutory reports and exports payslips to Estonian bookkeeping systems.

andevis.name: Andevis
andevis.description: A customisable Estonian HR suite whose modules can provide reviewed personnel and payroll inputs.

eeva.name: Eeva (Eetasoft)
eeva.description: Eeva's personnel module manages core employment records and is linked to Eeva payroll. Data would enter bureau payroll only through reviewed imports.

bureau.title: For accounting bureaus
bureau.body: Give every client your full attention. Keep their books and payroll together in one organised workspace.
bureau.clients_body: Switch between client companies in one workspace, with separate books and a clear overview for each.
bureau.payroll_body: Create a payroll draft for each client organisation in one click, then review and approve payslips and ledger postings.
bureau.matches_body: See why a bank transaction matches a document, review the evidence, and confirm before posting.
bureau.tax_body: Prepare KMD and VAT workpapers, check the figures, and mark them reviewed before exporting.

pricing.title: Simple pricing for every FastSME product.
pricing.lede: Every Fast* product uses the same two options: bring your own cloud for free, or host with us for €1 per month.
pricing.byoc_body: Self-host on your own infrastructure or cloud. Full control of data and upgrades. No per-seat platform fee.
pricing.hosted_body: We run the product for you on FastSME-managed infrastructure. €1 per product per month.
